title: Install GlowTV on iPhone and iPad
description: Follow the GlowTV iPhone and iPad installation guide. Check App Store availability, learn the expected steps and understand personal IPA signing.
intro: The current public iPhone download is an unsigned IPA under the previous NodeCast name. Sign it with your own Apple account using Impactor. App Store availability is pending.
notice: [APP_STORE_URL] — awaiting a published listing. Existing personal IPA installation needs signing; a seven-day free certificate must be refreshed. An unsigned IPA cannot be installed by tapping it.

steps.title: Download the iPhone IPA
steps.text: Open the iPhone download page on your computer and download the published IPA from GitHub. Compare the checksum if you verify files.
steps.result: The versioned NodeCast IPA is saved on your computer.

steps.title: Install Impactor on your computer
steps.text: Get Impactor from its official maintainer’s GitHub releases at github.com/claration/impactor/releases. On Windows, install the Apple device drivers if your phone is not detected.
steps.result: Impactor opens and can recognize Apple devices.

steps.title: Connect and trust your computer
steps.text: Unlock your iPhone, connect it by USB and tap Trust when prompted. Select your device in Impactor.
steps.result: Your iPhone appears in the device selector.

steps.title: Sign and install the IPA
steps.text: Select the downloaded IPA in Impactor and follow its signing instructions with your own Apple account. Use the same account and identifier for updates.
steps.result: The signed app appears on your iPhone.

steps.title: Open the app
steps.text: Follow any iOS prompts to trust your own developer profile or enable Developer Mode. Open NodeCast and add your own playlist.
steps.result: You can watch without keeping your computer on.

steps.title: Refresh personal signing
steps.text: Free Apple signing usually needs renewal every seven days. Re-sign over the existing app before expiry; avoid uninstalling it so your local profiles remain.
steps.result: The signing certificate stays valid and your profiles remain available.

title: Install the GlowTV APK on Android
h1: Make room for a better player.
description: Install the GlowTV APK on your Android phone using the official release. Learn source permissions, file installation and how to verify the download.
intro: Download only from glowtv.app or the project’s GitHub Releases. Keep your existing app installed when updating to preserve local profiles.

steps.title: Download the official APK
steps.text: Open the Android download page and choose Download APK. It links directly to the published GitHub release; the current file still uses the NodeCast name. Compare the SHA-256 if you verify files.
steps.result: The versioned Android phone APK appears in Downloads.

steps.title: Allow this installation source
steps.text: If prompted, open Settings for your browser or file manager and turn on Allow from this source. Do not disable device-wide security scanning.
steps.result: Android permits this app to open the APK installer.

steps.title: Open the downloaded file
steps.text: Open the downloaded NodeCast-mobile APK in Downloads.
steps.result: Android shows the NodeCast installation confirmation.

steps.title: Install the player
steps.text: Tap Install and wait for completion.
steps.result: You can choose Open. Turn off the source permission afterwards if you no longer need it.

title: Install GlowTV on Android TV and Google TV
description: Set up GlowTV on Android TV or Google TV with a store-first installation guide. Find the sideloading fallback and learn where official APKs belong.
intro: Use the Play Store when GlowTV has a published TV listing. Until then, a verified TV APK is the fallback once a release is available.
notice: [PLAY_STORE_URL] — TV store listing pending. Choose the TV APK rather than the phone APK.

steps.title: Check the TV download page
steps.text: Open GlowTV’s TV download page on your phone or computer and check release availability.
steps.result: You know whether a verified store link or TV APK is available.

steps.title: Choose the published TV APK
steps.text: The Play Store listing is pending. Choose Download TV APK on the official TV download page; it links directly to the published GitHub file.
steps.result: You have the versioned NodeCast TV APK, rather than the phone APK.

steps.title: Use the official APK as a fallback
steps.text: Transfer the downloaded TV APK using your trusted file-transfer app. Open it with a TV file manager.
steps.result: The TV asks whether this file manager may install unknown apps.

steps.title: Allow the source and install
steps.text: Allow installs for that file manager only, then confirm Install. Return the permission to off after installation if you do not need it.
steps.result: The published NodeCast TV player launches with a remote-friendly interface.

title: Install GlowTV on Fire TV and Firestick
h1: A brighter evening on Fire TV.
description: Install GlowTV on Fire TV or Firestick with Downloader and the official TV APK. Learn source permissions, release availability and remote setup.
intro: Use the Android TV / Fire TV edition. The phone APK is not designed for your remote.
notice: No Downloader code or Amazon listing is published yet. Use the official TV download page to get the direct GitHub APK; the current public file still uses the NodeCast name.

steps.title: Install Downloader
steps.text: Open the Amazon Appstore on your Fire TV and install Downloader by AFTVnews.
steps.result: Downloader appears in your apps.

steps.title: Enable developer options if needed
steps.text: Open Settings → My Fire TV → About. If Developer Options is hidden, select your device name seven times, then return to My Fire TV.
steps.result: Developer Options becomes available. Menu names vary by Fire OS version.

steps.title: Allow Downloader to install apps
steps.text: Open Developer Options → Install unknown apps and enable Downloader. On older Fire OS, use Apps from Unknown Sources.
steps.result: Downloader can open the Android package installer.

steps.title: Open the official TV download
steps.text: Enter https://glowtv.app/download/tv/ in Downloader, then select Download TV APK. The button opens the direct GitHub download. A short Downloader code has not been assigned.
steps.result: The versioned NodeCast TV APK downloads from the official GitHub Release.

steps.title: Install and open the player
steps.text: Confirm Install, then Open. You may delete the downloaded installer file afterwards.
steps.result: You can navigate the app with the D-pad and Select button.

title: How to Add an M3U Playlist in GlowTV
description: Add an M3U or M3U8 playlist link to GlowTV, or import a local file. Learn which URL to use and what to check when your provider returns an error.
intro: Use the channel playlist supplied by your provider. A single-video HLS manifest is not a channel list.

steps.title: Open Add playlist
steps.text: Choose the plus button or Add playlist from your profiles.
steps.result: The playlist setup panel opens.

steps.title: Choose M3U link or File
steps.text: For a link, select M3U link. For a local playlist, select File and use the system file picker.
steps.result: The correct fields or chosen filename appear.

steps.title: Enter the playlist details
steps.text: Give the profile a name. Paste the complete provider URL without changing its query parameters. Keep credentials private.
steps.result: Your details are ready to connect.

steps.title: Connect your playlist
steps.text: Choose Connect playlist. A 404 means the provider did not find the URL; ask for its exact channel-list address rather than guessing endpoints.
steps.result: Valid channels appear in the library. Refreshing cannot restore an expired provider subscription.

title: How to Log In with Xtream Codes in GlowTV
description: Connect GlowTV to your Xtream Codes provider with a server address, username and password. Learn safe setup and how to troubleshoot login errors.
intro: Use the details from your content provider. This is a provider login, not a GlowTV account.

steps.title: Choose Xtream
steps.text: Open Add playlist and select Xtream.
steps.result: You see server address, username and password fields.

steps.title: Name the profile
steps.text: Enter a memorable playlist name, such as Home provider.
steps.result: You can distinguish this profile from other playlists.

steps.title: Enter provider details
steps.text: Copy the full server address including http:// or https:// and any port, then enter your username and password exactly.
steps.result: The form is ready without spaces accidentally added to credentials.

steps.title: Connect the server
steps.text: Choose Connect playlist and wait for the provider response. If rejected, check subscription status and concurrent-connection limits with your provider.
steps.result: Your available live channels, movies and series load into the app.

title: How to Load the TV Guide (EPG) in GlowTV
h1: Know what’s on. And what’s next.
description: Load an XMLTV TV guide in GlowTV and match schedules to your playlist. Check channel IDs, refresh settings and provider-supported catch-up details.
intro: Programme schedules come from your provider’s XMLTV feed. The player cannot invent missing listings.

steps.title: Open Guide
steps.text: Select Guide in the app or TV rail.
steps.result: Your saved guide or guide setup appears.

steps.title: Add your XMLTV source
steps.text: Choose Add full TV guide or guide settings and paste the provider’s XMLTV URL.
steps.result: The feed is associated with the active profile.

steps.title: Save and refresh
steps.text: Choose Save and refresh guide. Allow time for a large feed to download and parse.
steps.result: Matching channel IDs show programme titles and times.

steps.title: Check missing schedules
steps.text: Confirm that the playlist channel IDs match the XMLTV IDs. Check the provider timezone and feed freshness.
steps.result: Provider-supported, completed programmes inside an archive window can offer catch-up.

title: How to Fix Buffering in GlowTV
h1: A calmer path back to play.
description: Troubleshoot IPTV buffering in GlowTV by checking your network, provider limits, live format and playback engine without sharing private credentials.
intro: Try one change at a time. A player cannot fix an overloaded provider or an unavailable stream.

steps.title: Check a second channel
steps.text: Play another channel and then a movie from the same provider.
steps.result: You learn whether the problem affects one stream, live TV or all content.

steps.title: Check your connection
steps.text: Compare Wi-Fi with Ethernet on TV where available. Pause large downloads and check whether your provider permits your current connection.
steps.result: A stable connection reduces avoidable interruptions.

steps.title: Check provider limits
steps.text: Close other IPTV players using the same subscription and confirm the provider’s simultaneous-stream limit.
steps.result: The subscription has a free connection available.

steps.title: Try another live format or engine
steps.text: Open the on-screen playback settings. Try an available HLS / MPEG-TS format or built-in engine; change only one choice at a time.
steps.result: You can identify a format or engine compatibility issue.

steps.title: Report a useful problem
steps.text: Include app version, device model, OS version, playback engine and whether other channels work. Remove all URLs, credentials and tokens.
steps.result: Support can reproduce the symptom without receiving your account details.

title: GlowTV Privacy
description: Learn how GlowTV stores provider profiles, settings and encrypted backups on your device, and how network checks contact external service providers.
intro: No GlowTV account is required. This policy describes the current app and this static website.
sections: Local profiles

The app stores provider details on your device. Sensitive profile data uses platform secure storage where available. Playback contacts the server you configure; that provider can see your connection and requests.
Network and public IP checks

Public IP and location checks contact an external IP service. They reveal your public address to that service. A home-IP comparison does not verify that a VPN is connected or that traffic is encrypted.
Backup and transfer

Exported backups can include server credentials and family-control settings. They are encrypted with a password you choose. Keep the file and password private; GlowTV cannot recover a forgotten backup password.
Website and analytics

This website has no analytics enabled by default and no advertising trackers. GitHub Pages and your network provider may process technical connection logs. An analytics service must be documented here before it is enabled.
Deletion and contact
Remove a profile in the app to remove it from this device. Remove your exported backup files separately. Ask privacy questions at support@glowtv.app.

title: GlowTV Terms
h1: A player for the content you bring.
description: Read the terms for using GlowTV, a free open-source media player. Understand your responsibility for playlists, provider access and permitted content.
intro: By using GlowTV, you agree to use it only with content and services you are entitled to access.
sections: What GlowTV provides
GlowTV is a media player. It does not provide, sell, host or link to channels, media subscriptions or provider accounts. Optional support does not include content.
Your provider and rights
You are responsible for your playlists, credentials and rights to access the content. Provider subscriptions, availability and billing are separate from GlowTV.
Availability and warranty
The app is provided under GPL-3.0-only without warranty to the extent permitted by law. Stream compatibility and provider features vary. Read the license in the source repository.
Support
For app issues, include your device, OS and app version. Never post provider passwords or complete playlist URLs in public issues. Contact support@glowtv.app.

title: GlowTV Legal and Copyright
description: Read GlowTV’s content disclaimer, open-source license and copyright information. See how demo artwork and third-party website photography are credited.
intro: GlowTV is independent software. A player does not grant rights to the content you open with it.
sections: Content disclaimer
GlowTV does not sell, host, provide or endorse unauthorized channels or media. Use only playlists and content you are legally entitled to access.
Open-source attribution

GlowTV builds on the open-source Nodecast project. Original copyright and GPL-3.0-only notices remain in LICENSE, NOTICE and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md in the source repository. Historical names and internal identifiers remain where needed for attribution and update compatibility.
Demo content and photography

Current app screenshots use original abstract demo scenes, invented channel names and generated artwork. Website photographs are licensed from Pexels; source URLs and license details are recorded in website/CREDITS.md.
Copyright enquiries
Send specific copyright enquiries to support@glowtv.app. Include the material and its location. Do not send account credentials.
